title: Spectrum Station
description: It begins with motion — the soft hum of rails, the blur of glass, and a vivid sense you’re passing through something alive. Wola Tower and concrete block rise into vibrant sky streaked with restless colors. A light wind drifts across the facades. The trackside wall is layered with years of graffiti — names, fragments, ghosts of paint that never settle. It’s no longer a station but a rhythm made visible.
